ann.t: Press Release — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "Karur Vysya Bank announces financial results for the Quarter ended 30th September 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Updates — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Order received from The Hon ble Income Tax Appellate Tribunal'.

Press Release — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Karur Vysya Bank announces Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th June 2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Cessation — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr R Ramkumar as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of the company w.e.f. Jun 25, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Karur Vysya Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
